# Telekom
> Deutsche Telekom offers mobile, broadband, fiber, TV, devices, and connected home services for consumers in Germany.

Telekom.de is the main consumer portal for Telekom’s mobile, internet, fixed-line, TV, hardware, and smart home offerings, with tariff pages, availability checks, product options, and service information.

## Mobile & Promotions
- [Aktionen %](https://www.telekom.de/unterwegs/aktionen): Current mobile and device promotions, discounts, and limited-time offers.
- [Mobilfunk](https://www.telekom.de/unterwegs): Overview of Telekom mobile plans, smartphones, and on-the-go services.
- [5G](https://www.telekom.de/netz/5g): Information about Telekom’s 5G network, coverage, and benefits.
- [Prepaid](https://www.telekom.de/unterwegs/prepaid): Prepaid mobile plans, options, and SIM offers for flexible usage.
- [Handys & Smartphones](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/handys): Smartphone catalog with current devices and contract combinations.
- [Tablets](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/tablets): Tablet devices and mobile data plan combinations.
- [Smartwatches](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/smartwatches): Connected watches and wearable devices with mobile options.

## Internet & Fixed-Line Tariffs
- [Internet](https://www.telekom.de/shop/festnetz): Main fixed-line and home internet product overview.
- [DSL-Tarife](https://www.telekom.de/shop/tarife/internet-tarife): DSL and home internet tariffs for private customers.
- [Für junge Leute unter 28](https://www.telekom.de/shop/tarife/internet-tarife-young): Discounted internet tariffs for young customers under 28.
- [Internet-Tarife ohne Laufzeit](https://www.telekom.de/shop/tarife/internet-tarife-flex): Flexible home internet plans without long contract commitment.
- [Verfügbarkeitsprüfung](https://www.telekom.de/netz/dsl-vdsl-lte-verfuegbarkeit): Check DSL, VDSL, and LTE availability at a specific address.
- [Zubuchoptionen](https://www.telekom.de/optionsuebersicht/festnetz): Add-on options for fixed-line and home internet contracts.
- [Festnetz](https://www.telekom.de/festnetz): Overview of fixed-line services, internet, and home connectivity.

## Fiber & Network Expansion
- [Glasfaser-Tarife](https://www.telekom.de/netz/glasfaser): Fiber tariffs, product details, and availability information.
- [Für privates Eigentum](https://www.telekom.de/netz/glasfaser/neubauprojekte): Fiber information for private property owners and new building projects.
- [Für gewerbliches Eigentum](https://www.telekom.de/netz/glasfaser/glasfaser-gewerbe): Fiber solutions and expansion information for commercial properties.
- [Glasfaser-Ausbau](https://www.telekom.de/netz/glasfaser/glasfaserausbau): Status and information on Telekom’s fiber rollout and expansion.
- [Glasfaser-Vorteile](https://www.telekom.de/netz/glasfaser-vorteile): Benefits of fiber internet for speed, stability, and future readiness.
- [Netz](https://www.telekom.de/netz): Network topics including coverage, expansion, and infrastructure.
- [LTE](https://www.telekom.de/netz/lte): Information about LTE coverage and mobile broadband network performance.

## Home Networking & Routers
- [WLAN & Router](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/wlan-und-router): Routers, Wi‑Fi hardware, and home networking devices.
- [Mobile Router](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/mobile-router): Portable routers for mobile internet access.
- [WLAN Pakete](https://www.telekom.de/festnetz/heimvernetzung/wlan-pakete): Bundled Wi‑Fi packages for improved home connectivity.
- [WLAN Optimierung](https://www.telekom.de/festnetz/heimvernetzung/wlan-optimierung): Services and products to improve Wi‑Fi performance at home.
- [Mesh WLAN](https://www.telekom.de/shop/festnetz/mesh-wlan): Mesh Wi‑Fi solutions for broader and more stable home coverage.
- [Festnetztelefone](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/festnetz-telefone): Corded and cordless phones for home fixed-line use.
- [Geräte](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete): Device catalog for phones, routers, tablets, and accessories.

## TV & Entertainment
- [MagentaTV](https://www.telekom.de/tv): TV and streaming service overview with packages and features.
- [MagentaTV Tarife](https://www.telekom.de/shop/tarife/tv-tarife): TV tariff options and package comparisons.
- [Streaming](https://www.telekom.de/unterhaltung/streaming): Streaming-related offers and entertainment services.
- [Unterhaltung](https://www.telekom.de/unterhaltung): Entertainment products including TV, streaming, and partner services.
- [MagentaTV App](https://www.telekom.de/tv/magentatv-app): Information about using MagentaTV across supported devices.
- [Receiver & TV Hardware](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/tv-und-audio): TV receivers and related entertainment hardware.

## Smart Home & Connected Products
- [Smart Home](https://www.telekom.de/smarte-produkte/smart-home): Telekom smart home overview, use cases, and connected living products.
- [Smart Home Geräte](https://shop.telekom.de/smart-home): Smart home device shop with compatible hardware and bundles.
- [Smarte Produkte](https://www.telekom.de/smarte-produkte): Overview of connected products and digital home solutions.
- [Sicherheit](https://www.telekom.de/smarte-produkte/sicherheit): Smart security products and home protection solutions.
- [Energie](https://www.telekom.de/smarte-produkte/energie): Smart energy-related products and connected home controls.

## Devices & Hardware
- [Handys](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/handys): Smartphones available with Telekom plans or standalone purchase.
- [Tablets](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/tablets): Tablet hardware for mobile work, media, and connectivity.
- [Smartwatches](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/smartwatches): Wearables and smartwatches with connectivity options.
- [WLAN und Router](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/wlan-und-router): Home networking hardware including routers and Wi‑Fi accessories.
- [Festnetz-Telefone](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/festnetz-telefone): Home telephony devices for fixed-line customers.
- [TV und Audio](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/tv-und-audio): Entertainment hardware such as TV receivers and audio devices.
- [Zubehör](https://www.telekom.de/shop/geraete/zubehoer): Accessories for mobile devices, networking, and home electronics.

## Service & Customer Support
- [Hilfe & Service](https://www.telekom.de/hilfe): Central support area for products, contracts, and troubleshooting.
- [Kontakt](https://www.telekom.de/kontakt): Contact options for customer service and support inquiries.
- [Störung](https://www.telekom.de/hilfe/hilfe-bei-stoerungen): Assistance for outages and service disruptions.
- [Rechnung](https://www.telekom.de/hilfe/rechnung): Billing help and invoice-related support information.
- [Umzug](https://www.telekom.de/hilfe/vertrag-meine-daten/umzug): Moving service information for transferring Telekom contracts.
- [Kundencenter](https://www.telekom.de/kundencenter): Customer account area for managing contracts and services.

## Company & Network Information
- [Netz](https://www.telekom.de/netz): Information about Telekom’s mobile and fixed network infrastructure.
- [Glasfaser](https://www.telekom.de/netz/glasfaser): Fiber network information, rollout, and product entry point.
- [5G](https://www.telekom.de/netz/5g): 5G network details, availability, and technology overview.
- [LTE](https://www.telekom.de/netz/lte): LTE network information and mobile broadband coverage.
- [Telekom Karriere](https://www.telekom.com/de/karriere): Career information from Deutsche Telekom’s corporate site.
- [Deutsche Telekom Unternehmensseite](https://www.telekom.com/de): Corporate information, investor, media, and company topics.
